focus_language: depth as truth: a single scene light, a strict luminance ladder, and glass reserved for surfaces that genuinely float

principles.depth_is_semantic: Elevation always encodes stacking truth. A surface is only translucent when it floats over live content; content-bearing surfaces are opaque.
principles.one_scene_light: Every edge highlight, shadow, and specular hint derives from one window-global key light. No per-component shadow improvisation.
principles.chroma_only_for_meaning: Accent, focus, status, and chart series own all saturated color. Structural surfaces stay near-neutral so glass reads calm.
principles.glass_recedes_with_density: Compact density demotes veil materials to solid and shrinks radii by one step; premium at leisure, utilitarian under load.

solid.meaning: Content-bearing surfaces: canvas, panels, cards, insets.
solid.cpu_oracle: exact fill plus analytic gradient bands

veil.meaning: Persistent chrome floating over app content: header bar, navigation rail, command palette, toasts.
veil.budget: combined veil area must stay under 25% of the viewport
veil.cpu_oracle: vertical ambient-tint band + edge highlight, fallback reason recorded

glass.meaning: Transient overlays only: menus, popovers, dialog scrims.
glass.budget: one live glass layer per interaction; scrims excluded
glass.cpu_oracle: warm ambient-tint band + overlay shadow pair, fallback reason recorded

palette.comment: Dark theme is primary for the showcase. Structural surfaces follow a strict luminance ladder; hue drift between steps is limited to a cool-to-warm ambient shift.

luminance_ladder.comment: Structural depth is encoded as ordered relative luminance steps so hierarchy survives high contrast and reduced transparency.

typography.numerals: tabular in tables, charts, and inspectors

spacing.density_material_rule: compact demotes veil to solid and reduces every radius token by one step

shape.comment: Continuous-curvature (superellipse) corners are the signature shape; the CPU path rasterizer owns them exactly.

elevation.comment: Every elevated surface casts a two-layer analytic shadow: a tight contact layer and a soft ambient layer, both derived from the scene key light.

light.rule: edge highlights appear on the top and leading edges only, opposite falloff feeds the contact shadow

expressive.use: overlay entrance, route transitions, material condensation

motion.material_entrance: glass condenses: blur radius and tint animate together; opacity fades are reserved for reduced motion
motion.reduced_motion_substitution: snap or bounded opacity fade, never a global duration multiplier

focus.rule: focus ring pairs a 2dp outer ring with a 1dp inner separation hairline so it stays visible on glass and solid in every theme

hover.treatment: surface.interactive fill plus trailing state marker; never color-only

pressed.treatment: chrome inset 2dp, elevation drops to base, spring snappy

contrast_floors.enforcement: token inspector reports computed contrast per node; failures block showcase conformance
